mentions.name: iOS drum practice app
mentions.description: An iOS app for structuring weekly drumming practice sessions, planned with a user-base of one. Practice is organized into lessons made up of patterns: the user chooses a lesson, practices its patterns, and logs the BPM achieved for each, working from musical notation.
mentions.problem: The author wants help structuring his (currently inconsistent) weekly drumming sessions.
mentions.audience: The author, a beginner-intermediate drummer (planned user-base of 1).
mentions.source_excerpt: I'm building an iOS app (with plan user-base of 1) to help me structure my (I wish they were) weekly drumming sessions.

evidence.value: I'm building an iOS app (with plan user-base of 1) to help me structure my (I wish they were) weekly drumming sessions.
